sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Frequent, with fine stitches in orifice of
urethra; burning; of peculiar odor. Cystitis, with pus,
mucus and tenesmus. Lithiasis.

Heart, — Palpitation, with oppression of chest. Pulse
weak, pain about left shoulder and heart, associated
with bladder disturbances. Great oppression in breath-
ing. Hydrothorax.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Rheumatic pain in back, especially
near shoulder and limbs. Pain at acromion process of
left scapula under clavicle and down arm, with feeble
pulse.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Antidote : Aeon. ; Apis.

Compare: Physalis Alkekengi — Winter cherry —
{Enuresis; Lithiasis; has marked diuretic action.) Dig-
ital.; Sarsap.; Spigelia.

sections.label: eyes
sections.text:
^ Sight and Eyes. Increased acuteness of vision.
Stitches and tickling in the eyes.
Aching of the brain near the eyes.
Pains in the eyeballs.
Drawing pain over eyebrows all across.

ASPARAGUS OFFICINALIS. 224

^ Smell and Nose. I l Frequent sneezing ; after smelling the
tincture.

Corjza, with slight dryness and swelling inside, then impeded
entrance of air ; gets violent with frequent discharge of a
thin white fluid from 1. nostril ; irritation to sneeze, and fre-
quent sneezing.

Later with the catarrh a pressing pain from root of nose to fore-
head; next day, at 9 a.m., dry coryza ; later running ; want
of smell ; violent sneezing ; the 3d day discharge of mucus
from the r. nostril.
" Face. Increased heat of the face.

Burning of the cheeks.

■ Countenance pale, wax- like and hloated.

■ General expression of anxiety and distress. See 29.

^^ Teeth and Gums. Painless cavity ; exfoliation of a carious
molar.

■ Relieved toothache.

*^ Taste, Tongue. Taste : sweetish, insipid ; coppery ; bitter-
sweetish on the tongue.
Smarting feeling on the tongue.
^^ Inner Mouth. Saliva increased ; sweetish, as if mixed with

blood; diminished; later more copious.
'^ Palate and Throat. Almost constant hawking, with a rough
feeling in the throat.
Copious discharge of tenacious mucus from the throat.

■ Deglutition difficult. ^Hydrophobia.

■ Burning in the throat.

" Appetite, Thirst. Increased thirst.

Feeble appetite.
* Eating and Drinking. After breakfast : cough remitted ;
pain in chest.
After eating : palpitation. See 29.
Fullness and oppression after eating or drinking.

^^ Belching, Nausea and Vomiting. Belching of wind.

Nausea 5 a.m., on awaking; vomited the food taken the even-
ing before, with bile and much mucus, followed by a bilious
diarrhoea; after 15 minutes another attack of difficult vomit-

Retching bringing tears into the eyes, when attempting to cough.

Nausea after each exertion.
^'' Scrobiculum and Stomach. Pain in region of cardiac end of

stomach, extending thence to left shoulder.
^^ Abdomen, Loins and Groins. Sense of fullness in abdomen.

Griping in region of navel, which is painful when touched.

Drawing pains in both groins.
^^ Rectum and Stool. Discharge of much wind.

Insufficient stool in afternoon, notwithstanding a regular stool
in morning.

225 ASPARAGUS OFFICINALIS.

Feces bilious after vomiting. See 16.

Bilious diarrhoea, with colic.

A peculiar urging, with difficult, hard fecal discharge ; haemor-
rhoids bleed much more.

Burning and soreness at the anus.
" Urinary Organs. • Nephritis.

Nephritic colic.

Urging to urinate ; evening 1st day.

Urging to urinate ; urine of a tolerably strong odor.

Frequent scanty discharge preceded by a sensation as if
something was sticking in the urethra, with slight burning.

I I Frequent urination, with fine stinging in the meatus, followed
by stitches out of the urethra.

I Urine scanty, straw-colored and offensive.

Cutting and burning in urethra.

Strangury.

Burning in urethra 6 A.M. ; 8th day,

After urination burning in the urethra, with sensation as if
some was still passing.

■ Increased urine, beer-brown, without sediment.
• Diabetes.

I When urinating, particularly when voiding the last drops,
rheumatic, constricting pain in cardiac region, forcing him
to cry out ; turns blue in the face, d Dropsy of chest.

Urine : straw-colored, becoming turbid and full of motes, which
settle as a whit« flocculent sediment.

Urine of a peculiar odor.

Urine of unpleasant odor ; 2d day. — N.

Urging to urinate; urine strong smelling.

Urine smells like cats' urine.

Urine bloody.

The urine deposits a greasy sediment on the sides of the vessel.

Reddish deposit on the sides of the vessel.

iLithiasis.

I Gravel passing in small quantities with urination.
"^"^ Male Sexual Organs. Sexual excitement.

Stitching on the r. side of the glans penis.

Swelling of the penis, with erection and urging to urinate.
^^ Female Sexual Organs. Promotes the flow of the menses.

The flow continued a day longer than usual.

■ Relieved prurigo pudendi in women, aet. 40.

25 Voice and Larynx. Continual hawking and hemming, with
sensation of roughness in throat.
Talks in a nasal voice during coryza.
^® Respiration. Difficulty of breathing when moving or going up
stairs.
At night he was obliged to sit up in bed to relieve his breathing.

VOL. II. — 15.

ASPARAGUS OFFICINALIS. 226

■ Great oppression; breathing rapid, difficult, increased after
being in bed some time.

Breathing: I rapid, labored, sighing ; I I difficult when moving
or ascending ; difficult at night, must sit up in bed.
^"^ Cough. Hawking and inclination to cough ; mucus not readily
loosened, paroxysms of cough, which brought it up.

Tickling and inclination to cough, but expectoration was diffi-
cult.

Cough, with inclination to vomit.

Cough distressing, with fullness of the chest and copious mu-
cous sputum.

Cough in paroxysms from mucus, which is not easily detached.

Cough remitted one hour after breakfast.

Less inclined to hawk and cough ; 5th day ; ■< rising from
deep in the throat.

Spitting blood.
^^ Inner Chest and Lungs. Stitches, especially about the left
scapula, when inspiring.

Pains relieved by throwing the chest forward and head back-
ward.

iHydrothorax ; often with heart disease or gouty diathesis
of old people.

I Unusual fullness of the chest.

Constriction of the chest ; tension, increased by a deep breath.

Chest feels as if hollow, with external heaviness.

Sudden darting through the right side of the chest.

Stitching pains in the region of chest.

^® Heart, Pulse and Circulation, Slight sensation of stitching
in the region of the heart after eating.

■ Heart's throb visible, especially at night; ■very strong and

extended over an unnaturally large area ; throbbing carotids;
murmurs.
Palpitation : I I while sitting, the leaves of the book in his
hands tremble ; I I with anxious restlessness, increased by
motion or ascending; ■with oppression of the chest.

■ Heart's action weak ; pulse feeble. See 32.

I I Heart's stroke two-fold, irregular, quickened.

Pulse accelerated when sitting; ■slow, weak; ■irregular and

feeble.
'^ Neck and Back. Rheumatic pains between the scapulae.
Fifth and sixth vertebrae pain.
Pains in loins at the beginning of the false vertebrae ; 4 p.m.,

5th day.
Pain at the acromion process of the left scapula, also under the

clavicle and down the arm, with exceeding feebleness of

pulse.
Sensation when sitting as if something were darting through

small of back toward sacral vertebrae.

227 ASPARAGUS OFFICINALIS.

^^ Upper Limbs. Rheumatic pains in the region of the r. axilla.

Pain in region of the shoulder on touching it.

1 I Pains on the tip of the left shoulder. See 48.

I Pain at the acromion process of the left scapula, under the
clavicle and down the left a,rm ; pulse feeble.
^^ Lower Limbs. The right leg and foot are the weakest.

On awaking and stretching cramps in the left calf, better from
rubbing.

While walking, pain as from dislocation in the neck of the right
thighbone. See 45.

Muscles in the middle of the thigh feel bruised, worse ascend-
ing, sore pain on touching it.

Drawing in the left toe, which had years ago been cut with an
axe.
^' Rest. Position. Motion. Sitting : breathing > ; pulse ac-
celerated.

Throwing chest forward and head backward : pains better.

Coughing : retching and lachrymation.

Exertion : nausea worse.

When urinating : pain in cardiac region.

Moving or ascending : difficult respiration ; palpitation in-
creased ; pain in thigh muscles.

Inspiration : stitches about left scapula.

Stretching : cramp in calf.

Walking : pain neck of right femur.

■ Motion aggravates most pains.

Compelled to throw chest forward and head backward to find
relief of pains in loins and elsewhere.
'® Nerves. I Great languor and disinclination to physical or men-
tal exertion.

Very much prostrated, pulse irregular. See 48.
^^ Sleep. Sleepiness and yawning.

Sleep uneasy and disturbed by oppressed breathing.
'^ Time. 5 a.m. : nausea on awaking.

6 A.M. : burning in urethra.

9 A.M. : dry coryza.

Afternoon : slight vertigo ; insufficient stool.

3 P.M. : some fever ; weak and drowsy.

4 P.M. : pains in loins.
Evening : urging to urinate.

Night : orthopnoea ; heart beats visibly.
*° Chill. Fever. Sweat. Slight chilliness with some sleepiness.
Slight fever ; weak ; drowsy.
Increased warmth.

■ Suppression of sweat.

*^ Locality and Direction. Right : mucus from nostril ; stitch-
ing side of glans penis ; darting through side of chest ; pains
in axilla ; leg and foot weak ; pain neck of femur.

ASPARAGUS OFFICINALIS. 228

Left : ache in temple ; thin discharge from nostril ; pain car-
diac end of stomach ; pain in shoulder ; stitches about
scapula ; pain tip of shoulder (acromion process), under cla-
vicle, and down arm ; cramp in calf; drawing in toe.

Symptoms go from right to left.

Below upwards : pain from root of nose ; pain cardiac end of

sections.label: stomach
sections.text:
Above downwards : pain in left shoulder.
*^ Sensations. As if something was sticking in urethra.

As if urine was still passing after urination.

Chest feels hollow.

Cutting : in urethra.

Darting : through r. side of chest ; through small of back to-
ward sacrum.

Stitches : in eyes.

Stitches: out of urethra; in glans penis; about 1. scapula;
through chest ; in cardiac region.

Stinging : in meatus.

Burning : of cheeks ; in throat ; at anus ; in urethra.

Smarting : on tongue.

Soreness : at anus.

Aching : in temples ; in forehead ; of brain.

Pressure : in temples ; in forehead ; towards eyes from fore-
head; from root of nose to forehead.

Drawing pain : over eyebrows ; in groins ; in 1. toe.

Rheumatic pain : in cardiac region when urinating.

Rheumatic pain ; between scapulae ; in r. axilla.

Dislocating pain : in neck of r. femur.

Bruised feeling : in muscles of thigh.

Constricting pain : in cardiac region.

Constriction : of chest.

Cramps : in 1. calf.

Undefined pain : in eyeballs ; in chest ; in cardiac end of sto-
mach to 1. shoulder; at acromion process of 1. scapula; un-
der clavicle and down arm.

Roughness : in throat.

Fullness : in abdomen.

Heaviness : in forehead.

Heat : of face.

Tickling : in eyes.
** Tissues. ; Grout.

I Dropsies. See Hydrothorax, 28.

I Anasarca.

** Touch. Passive Motion. Injuries. Touch : umbilical re-
gion painful ; pain in shoulder ; pain in thigh muscles.
Pressure : pain in temples worse.
Rubbing : cramp in calf better.
: Soothes the pain occurring in a dislocated limb.

229 ASPAR.— ASTAC. FLUV.

iNumbness of the bitten part, extending over the whole arm.

6 Hydrophobia.
I Constant desire to be carried about in the arms.
^^ Stages of Life, Constitution. Man, set. 74, after Digit.

d Dropsy of chest.
*^ Relationship. Antidote : Aeon, (prostration, feeble pulse,

pain in shoulder) ; Apis.
Is antidotal to Coffea.
Side relations : Convallaria maj., Medeola virg., Trillium cer.,

Sarsap.
Compare: Arnic.^ Aurum mur., Oannab., Digit, (dropsy);
